headline: Record sales and orders drive a raised full-year outlook
summary_short: IDEX reported record Q2 FY2026 sales of $920.6M (+6.4% y/y, +5% organic) and record orders above $1.07B (+29% y/y), with diluted EPS of $1.93 (+10.9% y/y); the company raised full-year 2026 organic-growth guidance to 5%-6% and adjusted EPS guidance to $8.70-$8.85.
summary_long: IDEX posted record Q2 2026 sales of $920.6M (+6% y/y reported, +5% organic, +4% q/q) and record orders above $1.07B (+29% y/y), driven by HST segment strength in AI-driven data-center and semiconductor demand plus a $21.1M IEEPA tariff-refund benefit. Gross margin expanded 100bp to 46.3% on productivity, volume leverage, and price/cost, partly offset by unfavorable mix. Diluted EPS of $1.93 rose 11% y/y; adjusted diluted EPS of $2.32 rose 12%. Operating cash flow of $200.0M and free cash flow of $177.0M grew on tariff-refund receipts and higher earnings. IDEX returned $77.1M via buybacks and $53.9M in dividends, and raised FY2026 organic-growth guidance to 5%-6% and adjusted EPS guidance to $8.70-$8.85.

drivers.explanation: Organic sales growth of 5%, led by higher HST segment volumes from AI-driven data-center power and semiconductor demand plus positive price, partly offset by a $14.7M IEEPA tariff-refund customer-rebate reduction.
Gross margin rose 100bp on net productivity improvements, volume leverage, and positive price/cost (including a 150bp IEEPA tariff-refund benefit), partly offset by unfavorable mix.
Improved operational results discussed above, including the net IEEPA tariff-refund impact, which benefited diluted and adjusted EPS by $0.08 per share.
Operating and free cash flow rose on $21.1M of IEEPA tariff-refund cash receipts and higher earnings, partly offset by higher working capital and capex.
Management cited record orders above $1B, strong demand in advantaged end markets, and earnings above expectations as it raised full-year organic-growth and adjusted-EPS guidance.
